criteria.requirement: Repair default CheckedPMap key/value serializers and checked sequence default serializers to pass the actual format argument into nested CheckedType.serialize(format). A record field serializer must observe the same format whether direct, in a map, in a vector/set or through multiple levels. Preserve explicit __serializer__ authority and default format=None output; do not override caller policy, mutate records or claim arbitrary serialized dictionary keys become hashable. Incompatible key serialization remains an explicit normal error. Test actual nested values and custom serializers, not only mocked forwarding.
